if(!document.title.startsWith('Photomask-Cleaner'))throw Error('Project title');if(CleaningScene.colors.mask!=='#b9d8e8'||document.querySelector('.fluid-legend span:nth-child(2) i').style.backgroundColor!=='rgb(185, 216, 232)')throw Error('Mask legend');if(performance.getEntriesByType('resource').length)throw Error('Unexpected external resources');cleaning.seek(100);if(document.getElementById('theme')||document.body.classList.contains('light')||getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor!=='rgb(255, 255, 255)')throw Error('Single bright theme')

(async()=>{cleaning.setView('iso');cleaning.seek(115);const proto=WebGLRenderingContext.prototype,old=proto.bufferData;let writes=0;proto.bufferData=function(...a){if(a[2]===this.STATIC_DRAW)writes++;return old.apply(this,a)};const count=fn=>{writes=0;fn();return writes},frame=()=>new Promise(requestAnimationFrame),r={};try{r.unchanged=count(()=>cleaning.seek(115));r.view=count(()=>cleaning.setView('top'));r.sameView=count(()=>cleaning.setView('top'));writes=0;document.getElementById('machine').style.width='calc(100% - 2px)';await frame();await frame();r.resize=writes;document.getElementById('machine').style.width='';await frame();await frame();cleaning.setView('grip');r.movingGripCamera=count(()=>cleaning.seek(16));cleaning.setView('iso');cleaning.seek(115);}finally{proto.bufferData=old}if(r.unchanged!==0||r.sameView!==0||r.view!==1||r.resize!==1||r.movingGripCamera!==1)throw Error('Static cache invalidation '+JSON.stringify(r));return JSON.stringify({staticCache:'PASS',...r})})()

(()=>{const results=[];for(const [t,want]of[[0,''],[108,'湿洗中'],[121,'Dry（干燥）'],[130,''],[238,'循环完成']]){cleaning.seek(t);const state=cleaning.state(),status=document.getElementById('cleanState').textContent;if(status!==want||document.getElementById('topFlow').textContent!==(state.topSpray?'开启':'关闭')||document.getElementById('diw').textContent!==(state.backDIW?'开启':'关闭'))throw Error('Process status '+t);results.push({t,status,topSpray:state.topSpray,backDIW:state.backDIW});}return JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',results})})()

(()=>{for(const t of [0,108,121,197,238]){cleaning.seek(t);if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Page overflow');const bad=[...document.querySelectorAll('.steps button,.readouts b,.zone,.toolbar,header')].filter(e=>e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+1);if(bad.length)throw Error('Text overflow');}if(document.querySelectorAll('[data-step]').length!==29)throw Error('Step count');return JSON.stringify({layout:'PASS',width:innerWidth})})()
